objective: Prove the installed Lambda production dependencies/configuration match the validated document-pipeline architecture without starting sustained research or mutating scientific state.
dependency_checks: native systemd unit matches repository deployment unit
production env contains no OPENAI_API_KEY and points to an executable Codex binary
core research-engine venv and persistent artifact root exist
Docling native and standard/no-OCR runtimes/model cache exist
CodeFormulaV2 and PP-TableMagic isolated runtimes/model caches exist
at least two NVIDIA GPUs are visible and each model-family runtime can make a bounded CUDA allocation on its assigned GPU
PostgreSQL accepts connections and required durable tables are readable
policy_checks: localization-matrix.v2 covers every JobType and matches JOB_TIERS
EXTRACT remains STANDARD over authoritative-PDF context
VERIFY remains STANDARD with radius-0 cited-page hydration
paper-package context is not the production EXTRACT/VERIFY hydrator
local heavyweight model owners can be constructed from production env without downloads or process spawn
safety_checks: no QUEUED/RUNNING non-HUMAN jobs before bounded integration
acceptance runner performs no semantic model call and no scientific materialization
pass_condition: All dependency, policy, safety, GPU-allocation, and read-only health checks pass with daemon inactive/dead.
